# Direct Windows full-suite diagnostic

This supplementary diagnostic validates an exact reviewed repaired source closure. The immutable `RELEASE_SOURCE` commit in the helper is `78ea5a6b6e7cbb59eaaac06dcf9cc47451589073`, with Sources tree `fd3f153c2a1e195e7766a40a1585f6526c73794a` and archive SHA256 `e39c6ff67400d165b9e1829a4bbb11388d8bebc6a050683b563f96ef123d57d6`. The earlier normal SwiftPM run37699465385 timed out; its cause remains unknown. The original direct run37702810868 proved the complete666-name inventory, then exposed fifteen failures and a journal-decoding fatal error. Those original results remain unchanged. A repaired direct run does not relabel either earlier result or establish normal SwiftPM completion.

The dedicated `codex/windows-test-direct-diagnostic-*` push trigger and concurrency group do not match the original diagnostic trigger or portable-release branches. Publication remains with the sole delivery owner. The default-branch workflow-dispatch prerequisite has not been assumed.

The workflow keeps native ownership/drainage controls, protected policy/signing/observer tests, a complete native test build, full SwiftPM discovery, complete direct tests, release build and actual seven-operation provider acceptance. Release/provider steps run only after full direct completion, with ordinary failure gating. This diagnostic handoff changes only `.github` files. The separate reviewed runtime/test repairs are supplied by the immutable combined source commit; the diagnostic is refused unless all packaged input bytes match that commit.

The helper rejects any tracked or untracked packaged-input difference from the exact reviewed `RELEASE_SOURCE` commit and any `_SWIFTPM_SKIP_TESTS_LIST` presence; it retains only the absence boolean. It requires the existing x86_64 PE at `.build/x86_64-unknown-windows-msvc/debug/rightclick-mcpPackageTests.xctest`, records its SHA256/source and checks the hash after each phase. It reads installed SDK `Info.plist` versions to select the exact XCTest and Testing DLL directories in the same prepend order as SwiftPM6.2; no complete environment or process arguments are retained.

Before executing tests, the actual compiled runner's `--dump-tests-json` inventory must contain674 distinct names exactly equal to the preceding complete SwiftPM discovery. The extra eight methods are six framing controls, one exact port-grammar control, and one large discarded-stderr control. In addition, every one of the actual original666 names must remain present; substituting a different method while retaining a count fails closed. `.github/windows-native-baseline-tests.json` preserves the original native inventory and source/binary/log hashes, with its complete repository-LF bytes pinned in the helper. Only Git checkout CRLF-to-LF transport conversion is allowed; JSON reserialization, altered whitespace, bare/repeated carriage returns and content changes still fail the pin. Before parser controls, a data-free native baseline audit records raw/canonical/Git-blob SHA256 values and line-ending counts, and requires canonical checkout bytes to equal the reviewed Git blob. The old raw-byte condition is recorded separately so the native artifact can establish whether that condition rejects the actual Windows checkout. The full XCTest invocation supplies no arguments or filter. A zero exit alone cannot pass: every expected case must have one start, one finish, no failure, and the complete674-case summary. Existing supported-platform skips are counted explicitly. The second full Swift Testing invocation supplies only its library selector; the exact reviewed source closure must contain no Swift Testing declarations, and actual output must prove its zero-test completion. Both full libraries must complete before release/provider gates can run.

Each invocation uses the already reviewed supervisor. The direct XCTest is now its retained root process handle, so its actual exit code is available even if fixtures retain pipe handles. The supervisor then cleans only that owned process tree and bounds pipe drainage. Inner full-XCTest deadline24minutes plus Swift Testing2minutes remains below the combined30-minute step. This bypasses SwiftPM's intermediate output collector for diagnosis; native CRT buffering may still affect when rows appear.

Ten local controls cover duplicate/changed/incomplete inventories, completion with missing, duplicate or failing cases, counted platform skips, original-name retention and baseline-file tampering, exact LF/CRLF equivalence without content-tampering or bare/repeated-CR acceptance, exact installed DLL selection and PE architecture. These parser/configuration controls pass on Mac; the actual native runner, DLL setup, inventory equality and full test completion remain RED until the dedicated Windows run provides them.

Primary source references: [SwiftPM test invocation](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-package-manager/blob/swift-6.2-RELEASE/Sources/Commands/SwiftTestCommand.swift), [Windows test environment](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-package-manager/blob/swift-6.2-RELEASE/Sources/Commands/Utilities/TestingSupport.swift), [installed DLL path derivation](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-package-manager/blob/swift-6.2-RELEASE/Sources/PackageModel/UserToolchain.swift), [SDK plist keys](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-package-manager/blob/swift-6.2-RELEASE/Sources/PackageModel/WindowsToolchainInfo.swift), [XCTest full-run and inventory semantics](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-corelibs-xctest/blob/swift-6.2-RELEASE/Sources/XCTest/Public/XCTestMain.swift).
